question: how many customers do we have
show total revenue per region
expected_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY region

question: list customers with their orders
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, o.total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id

question: show orders from last month
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE('now', '-1 month')

question: find customers who have not placed any orders
expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: show top 5 products by sales
expected_sql: SELECT product, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY product ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: revenue by quarter
expected_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-Q', order_date) AS quarter, SUM(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY quarter

question: customers from EU or US regions
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE region IN ('EU', 'US')

question: average order value per customer
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(o.amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name
